provenance._comment: Where each group of constants comes from. scripts/fetch_cdragon.py regenerates champions/traits/items/VERSION only -- it never writes this file, because Riot publishes none of the tables below (see docs/99_judgement_calls.md 2.1). xp_to_next_level and stage_base_damage were corrected on 2026-08-03 against the LoL wiki (TFT:Experience, Teamfight Tactics (game)); the previous values were invented and both favoured levelling -- see doc 99 entry 36.4. Note the wiki and community trackers disagree on stage 4-6 base damage (wiki 7/9/11, some trackers 8/10/12); the wiki is used. Set 18 (2026-09-24, docs/99_judgement_calls.md 161.11): level 7 odds (tftflow 18.2, esportstales), XP 7-10 (official 18.2 notes), 2-streak gold (op.gg, tft-lab) and stage 5-6 damage (op.gg, tftflow) were changed; income, interest, PvP gold, pool sizes and the other odds rows were re-confirmed against Set 18 sources. Stage 3-4 and 8+ damage and the level cap stay as shipped and are flagged unverified.
engine_artifact: augments.json tiers (docs/99_judgement_calls.md 152.4: the pool itself is fetched from CDragon since 17.1 was corrected, but Riot ships no tier field, so tiers are read off icon paths)

unverified: realm.cost_tiers (doc 99 entry 98: the schedule now covers every x-4, which real match data confirms is a no-combat round at every stage. The tier *offered* at 5-4 and later is not sourced -- 'cost = stage, capped at 5' continues the documented 1/2/3/4 pattern and is an assumption)
augments.rounds (doc 01 sec 9 explicitly flags the 2-1/3-2/4-2 reveal pattern as unconfirmed for the current patch)
augments (doc 99 entry 161.9: augments.json is the fetched pool, but 169 of its augments have no modelled behaviour and warn once when picked)
stage_base_damage (doc 99 entry 161.11: stages 5-6 are sourced for Set 18; stage 3 (5 vs 6), stage 4 (7 vs 8) and stage 8+ (150) are disputed between op.gg and tftflow and kept as shipped)
max_level (doc 99 entry 161.11: tft-lab gives a natural cap of 10, tftraits a cap of 11, and both odds sources print a level-11 row; how level 11 is reached is not sourced, so the cap stays 10)
realm (doc 99 entry 161.11: Set 18 replaces the Realm draft with a carousel at every x-4, and 1-1 is an opening encounter, not a draft; the schedule here is Set 17's until the carousel is modelled)
combat.movement_hexes_per_second (doc 01 sec 9: not publicly documented, approximated)
combat.armor_mitigation_constant (doc 01 sec 9: exact curve coefficient unconfirmed)
round_structure.pve_rounds_per_stage (doc 01 sec 1: 'periodic PvE rounds' -- exact schedule not pinned)

combat.damage_mana_post_mitigation_basis (doc 99 entry 5.4: sources give the 1%/3%/42.5 numbers but do not say whether shield-absorbed damage counts toward the post-mitigation term; both readings are implemented)

role_mana_per_attack.Specialist (doc 99 entry 9.2: Riot states Specialists 'generate resources in their own unique way' without publishing per-champion rules; 0 models the documented Kayle case of generating none)
